target: obs.sh context isolation — a parallel run never inherits another run's context
cmd: mkdir -p .agentic; printf '%s' '{"observability":{"enabled":true}}' > .agentic/config.json; unset CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR AGENTIC_OBSERVE; AGENTIC_RUN_ID=run-a "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/observe.sh" context set --phase build --spec-id a.md; AGENTIC_RUN_ID=run-b "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/observe.sh" emit probe-b '{}'; AGENTIC_RUN_ID=run-a "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/observe.sh" emit probe-a '{}'; cat .agentic/observability/events-*.jsonl | jq -cs '{a: (map(select(.event=="probe-a")) | first), b: (map(select(.event=="probe-b")) | first)}'
